headline: Citigroup Maintains Neutral on Fifth Third Bancorp, Raises Price Target to $59
summary: Citigroup  analyst Benjamin Gerlinger   maintains Fifth Third Bancorp (NYSE:FITB) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $53 to $59.
